policy.note: Generated meshes must be closed 2-manifolds except named inspection windows. BodyParts3D source surfaces keep their original, non-watertight topology and are never repaired in place.

selfIntersection.note: Per-entity self-intersecting face pairs, from a BVH self-overlap test (mathutils.bvhtree.BVHTree.overlap against itself) that excludes face pairs sharing a vertex (expected touching, e.g. adjacent quads on the same tube). Generated (non-source-surface) entities must report zero unless listed here with a reason.

pilot-thick-filaments.reason: Detail LOD only: sparse illustrative myosin heads are short links protruding from each thick-filament tube surface and are not boolean-unioned into it. Out of scope for this remediation, which unions only the Z-disc lattice links (pilot-z-left/right) and the M-line links/nodes (pilot-m-line); tracked here rather than silently ignored.

knownUnresolved: BodyParts3D source surfaces FJ1442/FJ3365/FJ3381 contain backfacing (inconsistently wound) faces -- see the winding-consistency counts recorded per object by scripts/blender/audit-muscle-pilot.py. Source topology and winding are preserved unmodified; only the derived muscle-context decimate LOD and the muscle simulation-domain derivative are made normals-consistent.

Thin filaments intentionally overlap their anchoring Z-disc lattice, and the thick-filament array intentionally overlaps the M-line lattice, by anchoring design; the build reports these as informational crossEntityOverlaps in topology-report.json and they are not required to resolve.

crossEntityOverlaps.note: Informational only, never failing: intersecting face pairs between DIFFERENT entities in the same level/lod (e.g. thin filaments anchored inside their Z disc by design).
